name: Head Laser
special: Uses 2 shots per attack; each shot fewer lowers the damage by 1 CD (at least 4 CD and 1 shot).

name: Assaultron Head
special: Uses 2 shots per attack (Capacitor mods raise both damage and shots); each shot fewer lowers the damage by 1 CD (at least 4 CD and 1 shot).

name: Bow
special: Bows are rolled with AGI + Athletics and cannot be used in Power Armor.

name: Crossbow
special: Bows are rolled with AGI + Athletics and cannot be used in Power Armor.

name: Ballistic Fist
special: Uses a shotgun shell per attack; without one it is a normal unarmed attack.

name: Chainsaw
special: The melee damage bonus does not apply; the Flamer mod goes in addition to another mod.

name: Death Tambo
special: +1 complication range on sneak attacks with it, because of the noise.

name: Guitar Sword
special: +1 complication range on sneak attacks with it, because of the noise.

name: War Drum
special: +1 complication range on sneak attacks with it, because of the noise.

name: Detonator
special: Sets off Placed explosives linked to it as a minor action within Long range; removes their Delay.

name: Dynamite
special: Goes off the turn it is thrown; a longer fuse (PER + Explosives, difficulty 1) gives Delay (X).

name: Dynamite Bundle
special: The Delay rating is chosen when the bundle is placed.

name: Flash Bang
special: On a hit, everyone in the blast is stunned as by Stun; a miss has no effect.

name: Plastic Explosives
special: The Delay rating is chosen when the explosives are placed.

name: Powder Charge
special: Can trade Mine for Delay (X) and Placed with a PER + Explosives test (difficulty 1).

name: Smoke Grenade
special: Fills the zone with smoke: no sight into, out of or through it, +2 difficulty to attacks and PER tests in it; it clears once Effects are rolled at the end of a round.
